sections.name: Program Orientation
sections.detail: Introduce trainer and explain the full program structure and expectations. Explain deliverables, milestones, and the interview-readiness objective.

sections.name: Readiness Validation
sections.detail: Verify environment readiness: Zoom, Google Docs, folders, recording setup, camera position, lighting, microphone clarity, internet stability.

sections.name: Interview Foundations
sections.detail: Teach interview discipline: posture, eye contact, gestures, pauses, calm delivery, and stop discipline. Introduce Answer Structure: Direct answer -> Brief explanation -> Stop. Introduce STAR structure: Situation -> Task -> Action -> Result. HR answers: 60-90 seconds. Technical answers: 2-3 minutes.

sections.name: HR Question Coaching
sections.detail: Explain intent of HR questions, common mistakes, and structured answers using STAR. Emphasize honesty when the candidate does not know an answer.

sections.name: Niche Fundamentals
sections.detail: Teach core concepts and high-frequency interview topics using project-style explanations. Introduce Tool Explanation Method: 1. What the tool is 2. What problem it solves 3. Simple analogy 4. How it fits into the system.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Explain practice expectations and structured preparation approach.

2.title: Primary Weakness Repair and Guided Practice

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Review HR and niche responses. Reinforce clear structure, calm delivery, and stopping discipline.

sections.name: Project Interview Foundations
sections.detail: Explain how interviewers judge project answers: ownership clarity, metrics, STAR depth, logical flow, and failure awareness.

sections.name: Mandatory Project Scenario Coaching
sections.detail: Teach the 5 Mandatory Project Scenario Types: 1. Failure & Learning Story 2. Design Trade-off Decision 3. System Failure & Recovery 4. End-to-End Request Flow 5. Security & Compliance Scope. Ensure candidates use real experiences only.

sections.name: Failure & Trade-off Explanation
sections.detail: Teach how to explain technical decisions, constraints, trade-offs, and mistakes. Failure explanation flow: What went wrong -> Why it happened -> How it was detected -> How it was fixed -> What was learned.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Reinforce STAR storytelling and structured project explanation practice.

3.title: Introduction, Team Structure and Resume Defense

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Evaluate project explanations for STAR structure, metrics, ownership clarity, and logical explanation flow.

sections.name: Introduction Script
sections.detail: Teach structured introduction: background -> role -> skills -> projects -> strengths -> reason for change -> close.

sections.name: Team Structure & System Overview
sections.detail: Explain real-world team structure: Frontend, Backend, Data, AI/ML, DevOps, Security and how responsibilities are divided.

sections.name: Tools & System Thinking
sections.detail: Teach how to connect tools into one end-to-end system architecture: Frontend -> API Layer -> Queue/Messaging -> Processing Layer -> Database/Cache -> Monitoring/Logging. Explain inputs, outputs, ownership, monitoring, and failure handling at each step.

sections.name: Resume Defense
sections.detail: Ask probing resume questions and correct over-claiming ownership. Teach candidates to clearly state what they implemented vs what other teams owned.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign system explanation and resume-defense practice.

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Identify clarity gaps in system explanations and project ownership.

sections.name: Prompt Engineering
sections.detail: Teach structured prompt design: role context, constraints, assumptions, and conversation flow control.

sections.name: Persona-Based Interview Simulation
sections.detail: Teach Persona-Based Explanation Depth: Recruiter -> What the system does. Hiring Manager -> How it works. Architect -> Why design decisions were made.

sections.name: Resume Defense
sections.detail: Conduct deep probing and enforce calm, structured responses.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Explain persona-based practice tasks.

5.title: Small Talk, JD Mapping and Tools

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Review persona explanations and communication clarity.

sections.name: Small Talk Mastery
sections.detail: Train interview conversation skills: greetings, tone, posture, pacing, and smooth transition into technical discussion.

sections.name: JD Understanding
sections.detail: Teach how interviewers read job descriptions. Train candidates to align their project experience to multiple job roles.

sections.name: Tools & Technology Demo
sections.detail: Ask tool-related questions and ensure candidates explain them using the Tool Explanation Method.

sections.name: Resume Defense
sections.detail: Test composure and ownership clarity through interruptions and probing questions.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign JD mapping and explanation practice.

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Identify gaps in structured thinking affecting system design interviews.

sections.name: System Design Prompting
sections.detail: Teach how to structure prompts for design interviews and requirement discovery.

sections.name: System Design Framework
sections.detail: Teach system design sequence: Clarify problem -> Functional requirements -> Non-functional requirements -> Entities -> APIs -> Architecture -> Request flow -> Component deep dive -> Trade-offs -> Scalability.

sections.name: Trade-offs & Scalability
sections.detail: Train candidates to identify bottlenecks, scaling strategies, and design compromises.

sections.name: Diagram Usage
sections.detail: Teach when to draw architecture diagrams vs explain verbally.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign system design practice tasks.

sections.name: Homework Check
sections.detail: Confirm preparation progress and reinforce interview readiness expectations.

sections.name: Interview Environment Setup
sections.detail: Train candidates on professional setup: camera at eye level, neutral background, clear audio, steady camera, upright posture.

sections.name: Integrity & Verbal Control
sections.detail: Teach concise answers, honesty in uncertainty, and controlled speaking pace.

sections.name: GitHub Project Walkthrough
sections.detail: Review candidate project repository and challenge decisions with repeated 'why' questions to validate ownership and reasoning.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign concise explanation and listening practice.

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Evaluate listening and reasoning clarity.

sections.name: Active Listening
sections.detail: Train candidates to ask clarifying questions and restate the problem before answering.

sections.name: Document Reading
sections.detail: Teach extracting constraints and requirements from job descriptions or project documents.

sections.name: Adaptive Discussion
sections.detail: Introduce requirement changes during discussion to test adaptability.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign logical breakdown and first-principles explanation practice.

sections.name: Homework Review
sections.detail: Review reasoning clarity and explanation flow.

sections.name: Technical Round Awareness
sections.detail: Explain interview round types: coding, discussion, system design, and managerial rounds.

sections.name: First-Principles Reasoning
sections.detail: Teach explaining decisions using inputs, outputs, constraints, and trade-offs.

sections.name: GitHub Why Ladder
sections.detail: Repeatedly challenge technical decisions to test logical consistency.

sections.name: Homework Briefing
sections.detail: Assign resume explanation practice.

sections.name: Interview Warm-up
sections.detail: Conduct small talk and rapport-building simulation.

sections.name: JD & Resume Discussion
sections.detail: Ask detailed resume and job-mapping questions.

sections.name: Project Defense
sections.detail: Deep-dive into project architecture, decisions, metrics, and ownership.

sections.name: Technical/System Question
sections.detail: Present system design or coding problem and evaluate structured problem solving.

sections.name: Behavioral Questions
sections.detail: Assess integrity, stress handling, and coachability.

sections.name: Feedback
sections.detail: Provide structured feedback on communication, reasoning, and clarity.

sections.name: Wrap-Up
sections.detail: Summarize strengths, improvement areas, and next preparation steps.
